name: Thirty Spokes
notes: First overlay for netuid 99 as Thirty Spokes. This netuid was previously curated as Leoma; SubnetIdentitiesV3 at block 8823651 names netuid 99 "Thirty Spokes" with subnet_url https://www.thirtyspokes.ai/, and the project's own docs state it is "registered on Bittensor as Subnet 99". Leoma's 31 api.leoma.ai surfaces moved with it to netuid 36 (registry/subnets/leoma.json), where both the chain identity and Leoma's own docker-compose NETUID default place it. Thirty Spokes is a decentralized model router scored on benchmark quality per dollar; miners run the owner's benchmark suite inside their own confidential VM (Intel TDX) and publish a hardware-attested proof, and validators run no inference at all. Both surfaces below live-verified 2026-08-13 (HEAD 200).
